results.name: Friedman's Herald Square
results.address: Friedman's Herald Square, 132 W 31st St, New York, NY 10001

excerpts.text: … (Only in certain areas really) This place has such an awesome atmosphere, great service, and delicious food! Can't get enough on the taste and I RARELY go out to eat. This gives me a good indication of what establishments are truly Celiac friendly. So far been no bathroom issues, no breakouts and my blood is healthy! …
Great gluten free options. It's one of the few places that is consistently safe for those with Celiac Disease.

While many restaurants have gluten free items on their menus, most fail to recognize that celiac disease isn't a fad, and cross contamination is a real danger to those of us who have it. That's not an issue here. I've been here twice, and although it's a bit pricy on first glance, it's actually a bargain in reality. …

results.address: Noglu, 1266 Madison Ave, New York, NY 10128

excerpts.text: Only place completely gluten free in New York that I know. The caprese with bacon is a party. If you are celiac and walk on the upper east side, stick around.
Very good. Ideal for celiacs. Small and cozy.
GLUTEN FREE EVERYTHING. We just found out our son is GF and this place is saving our lives.

results.name: Senza Gluten Cafe & Bakery
results.address: Senza Gluten Cafe & Bakery, 171 Sullivan St, New York, NY 10012

excerpts.text: The atmosphere here is much more casual than that of the Senza Gluten restaurant. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND the chicken panini. This place is COMPLETELY SAFE for those with Celiac Disease and is very catering to many other common food allergies.
So delicious and celiac safe - morning with gluten goes into this space. So many options of sweets, breads and food that are a perfect texture and flavor!

A paradise for celiacs. They have a lot of variety of products and everything is delicious! The bread they make is impressive. Their sandwiches are great and the portions huge !!!!! They have a great variety of cakes, cakes and cookies .... Do not forget to try the chocolate cake, it is delicious! 100% gluten free so 100% safe!

results.name: Little Beet Table
results.address: Little Beet Table, 333 Park Ave South, New York, NY 10010

excerpts.text: I have Celiac Disease and I’m so grateful to have found The Little Beet Table in NYC. The food is amazing. I had the Squash Cavatelli pasta and it was truly incredible. The pasta was delightful and the sauce was smooth and creamy. We’re going back again before we leave the city!

Excellent food and service! Their whole menu is gluten free, so if you have a sensitivity or celiac’s this place is a dream! Our food was amazing and came promptly and tasted amazing. Would highly recommend for those looking for a healthier option in the city!

As someone who developed celiac in their twenties, I know what I'm missing when I eat gluten free versions of things. Pasta is one of those things which I have come to accept will never really be quite as tasty in it's GF version...so when I had the Rigatoni at the Little Beet, my mind was a bit blown. …

excerpts.text: One of the last places to get gluten free diner food in all of NYC, this place is amazing! I have celiac & always feel safe coming here.

They are well aware of safe gluten-free preparation and look out for cross-contamination. We had breakfast here twice and both times we received generous portions. …

excerpts.text: Awful. BAD PLACE FOR CELIAC. The chef refused to talk to us, even after repeat requests to talk about specific allergies. The waitstaff did not care or understand my allergies, and after repeat instructions willing dismissed them to bring out my food dangerous. DO NOT COME HERE. …

Wow! Loved this place. I have Celiac disease and everything is gluten free. So rare to find. I had the carbonara risotto and it was amazing. The ambiance was warm and inviting. For dessert I had the profiteroles and again was blown away. Great service as well. Will return.

… Even as California wine lovers, we were in love with the wine we enjoyed with our dinner. For anyone, literally anyone, you will enjoy this wonderful restaurant. For anyone with Celiac or gluten intolerance, you will LOVE this restaurant!
